question: Who among the following was the author of Gita Govinda, composed during the reign of Lakshmana Sena?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jayadeva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshmana Sena**

 
 
• Lakshmana Sen (1178-1205 AD), the ruler of the Sena dynasty, successfully demonstrated his military skills in many wars during the reign of his father.
 
• He had won by attacking against Gahadwal King Jaichand.
 
• He did military campaigns till Banaras and Allahabad.
 
• Also successfully faced the attacks of Kalchuri rulers.
 
• In 1202 AD, the Muslim invader Ikhtayaruddin Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji attacked its capital Lakhnauti.
 
• Laxmana Sen fled from there without fighting and continued to rule in East Bengal till 1205 AD.
 
• After that Vishwaroop Sen and Keshav Sen became weak rulers.
 
• 
 
The result was that the Sena kingdom came under the rule of the Deva dynasty.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gita ­Govinda written by Kavi Jaydeva in Kannada.
 
• Jayadeva was born in the middle of the 12th century and his birthplace was Kendubilwa.
 
• Gita ­Govinda describes the relationship between Krishna and Srimati Radhika and the Gopis (female cow herders) of Vrindavana.
 
• The Gita Govinda is organized into twelve chapters.
